items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Andy Iona in the context of records made by 'Louie' (Snub Mosley) with the Mills Brothers, not the interviewee.

ctx.x: I'm going to send you a list of all the records that Louie made from the time that we think he joined and to the time we think he left, we may find some others. A lot of that time when you were with him, he wasn't recording, he wasn't using his own band. Decca had him recording

with the Mills Brothers who was a small group and they had him recording with Andy Iona, they had him recording with Jimmy Dorsey's band; a lot of times he was not using his own band. You made all your records with him, clustered in a little bunch. I thought when you joined him I thought that he was still (inaudible), but I guess he wasn't.
